old: उससे भगवान् आत्रेय ने कहा: अग्निवेश, हमारे द्वारा या हमारे जैसे लोगों द्वारा भी ऐसी व्यवस्था करना सम्भव है कि व्यवस्था कर लेने पर औषध एकान्त रूप से सिद्ध हो, और उस प्रयोग-सौष्ठव का यथावत् उपदेश करना भी; क्योंकि ऐसा कोई नहीं है जो इस प्रकार उपदेश किए गए इसको धारण कर सके, या धारण करके वैसा आचरण कर सके या प्रयोग कर सके। क्योंकि दोष, भेषज, देश, काल, बल, शरीर, आहार, सात्म्य, सत्त्व, प्रकृति और वय की भिन्न-भिन्न अवस्थाएँ सूक्ष्म हैं, जिनका चिन्तन करने पर वे निर्मल और विपुल बुद्धि वाले की बुद्धि को भी व्याकुल कर दें, फिर अल्प बुद्धि वाले का क्या कहना। इसलिए हम इन दोनों का यथावत् उपदेश करेंगे: औषधों का सम्यक् प्रयोग, और बाद में सिद्धि-स्थान में व्यापन्न औषधों की व्यापत्तियों के साधन।

old: Then he should prepare: attendants endowed with good character, purity, good conduct, attachment, dexterity and courtesy, skilled in nursing care, well versed in all tasks, cooks of soup and rice, bathers, masseurs, lifters, those who lay the patient down and grinders of medicine, not unwilling in any task; likewise companions skilled in song, instrumental music, ullāpaka, verses, gāthās, tales (ākhyāyikā), itihāsa and purāṇa, knowing intentions, approved and knowing place and time; likewise lāva birds, kapiñjala birds, hares, hariṇa deer, eṇa deer, kālapucchaka deer, mṛgamātṛka deer and rams; a cow yielding milk, gentle, healthy, with a living calf, well provided with grass, shelter and drinking water; dishes, rinsing vessels, water tanks, maṇika jars, pots, piṭhara pans, paryoga vessels, kumbhī pots, jars, basins, saucers, ladles, mats, buckets, cooking pans, churners, leather, cloth, thread, cotton, wool and the like; and beds, seats and the like, with ewers and receptacles placed near, with well-arranged spreads, upper covers and pillows, with back-rests, convenient for use in the acts of lying down, sitting, oleation, sweating, oil massage, plaster, affusion, anointing, emesis, purgation, decoction enema, unctuous enema, head-evacuation, urination and defecation; grinding stones, very smooth, rough and medium, with well-washed upper stones; knives serving as equipment, a smoking pipe, an enema nozzle, an uttarabasti nozzle, a handful of kuśa grass, a balance and a measuring vessel; ghee, oil, muscle-fat, marrow, honey (kṣaudra), phāṇita, salt, fuel, water, madhu, sīdhu, surā, sauvīraka, tuṣodaka, maireya, medaka, curd, curd-scum, udasvit, sour gruel (dhānyāmla) and urines; likewise śāli rice, ṣaṣṭika rice, mudga, māṣa, barley, sesame, kulattha, badara, grapes, kāśmarya, parūṣaka, abhayā, āmalaka and bibhītaka, and substances of various kinds serving as means of oleation and sweating; and likewise medicines that remove upward, move downward, and act both ways, and those named binding, stimulating digestion, digesting, pacifying, Vāta-removing and so on; and whatever other equipment he would know of for counteracting ill effects, having reckoned them up, and whatever serves for attendant use: each such thing he should prepare.
